'''Resdin''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it was ravaged by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces to make a point to the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], which then surrendered without firing a shot. In the latter stages of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] fought the remaining pockets of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] within the city.
